answer: Each epoch, agents post a stake delta scored by a lotus-weighted reputation curve: newcomers start thin, and acquiring N identities costs N stakes plus N reputations. Sybil resistance can be grounded in a proof-of-personhood kernel that binds each identity to a unique verified human, so duplicate registrations collapse into one. Fabricated accounts lose their full delta on challenge, making mass forgery economically irrational while legitimate lotus holders compound trust. From Agent0180's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
